headline.window_description: A partial-artifact window exists only at r=0.98. All five probe extinction ratios fall between 0.971 and 0.979, so r=0.98 is the only ratio at which any artifact content survives truncation. At r=0.96 and below, artifact_fraction=0.000 for all probes.
headline.regime_description: There is no gradual degradation curve. Performance drops from 1.00 at r=1.00 to near 0.00 within a single 2-percentage-point step (r=1.00 → r=0.98), with the single exception of sea_04 which retains a correct answer at r=0.98.

r_lt_096_summary.note: All artifact_fraction values are 0.000 at r<=0.96. Behavior is identical to Stage C: sea probes output '93850' (filler tail-entity), rag probes output '0.0001' or '0.00' (prior-derived values).

findings.S2-F1: The partial-artifact window is a single 2% sliver (r=1.00 → r=0.98). All extinction ratios are in [0.971, 0.979], which falls between the r=0.98 and r=0.96 measurement points. No extended partial-artifact regime exists.
findings.S2-F2: At r=0.98, artifact survival does not guarantee correct answers. sea_04 (af=0.314) answers correctly; sea_01 (af=0.292) fails because the answer lot is in the truncated leading portion; rag_01 (af=0.198) lifts '0.9' from the surviving DOC 3 fragment (wrong value, present in the surviving tail); rag_02 (af=0.207) scores 0.50 (correct claim, wrong entity name — location 'Thornfield Basin' survives but not the array name 'Meridian-3'); rag_05 (af=0.046) effectively has no surviving artifact and fails.
findings.S2-F3: The rag_02 partial answer at r=0.98 is the clearest demonstration of partial-artifact degradation: with 20.7% of the artifact surviving, the model produces a semantically correct answer (the right array retains original firmware) but with wrong entity identification (location instead of array name), because the array name 'Meridian-3' was in the truncated leading portion. This is graded fabrication, not complete fabrication.
findings.S2-F4: Below r=0.96 (artifact extinct for all probes), outputs are fully determined by filler contamination. This is indistinguishable from Stage C behavior at r=0.85 and r=0.70. Finer resolution adds no new information in this regime.
